SELECT   DISTINCT R.VENDOR
FROM  DBO.VENDORRESULTS  V1 INNER JOIN
DBO.MASTERRECORDS M
ON V1.RECORDID=M.RECORDID
AND  CAST( V1.[CREATEDATE] AS DATE )>=CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE())
INNER JOIN  DBO.REQUESTS R ON M.REQUESTID = R.REQUESTID

DECLARE @RecordsStaged int DECLARE @RecordsInserted int DECLARE @ErrorRecords int DECLARE @InsertDate datetime DECLARE @AnswerErrors int DECLARE @Vendor varchar(80) DECLARE @SUBJECT_VENDOR VARCHAR(80) SET @InsertDate = @StartDateTime SET @VENDOR=@Vendor_variable SET @SUBJECT_VENDOR=(@VENDOR+' Vendor Results File Summary') SElECT @RecordsStaged = COUNT(*) FROM DBO.VENDORRESULTSSTAGING WHERE VENDOR=@VENDOR SELECT @RecordsInserted = count(*) FROM dbo.VendorResults V1 inner join dbo.MasterRecords m on v1.RecordID=m.RecordID and v1.CreateDate >= @InsertDate inner join dbo.Requests r ON m.RequestID = r.RequestID WHERE Vendor=@VENDOR SET @AnswerErrors = CASE WHEN @VENDOR= 'ELIZA' THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM dbo.ProcessLog WHERE LogMessage like '%Question%' AND CreateDate >= @InsertDate) ELSE 0 END SET @ErrorRecords = (@RecordsStaged - @RecordsInserted) + @AnswerErrors DECLARE @tableHTML NVARCHAR(MAX) ; SET @tableHTML = N'

Vendor Results for ' + convert(Varchar(10),getdate(),101) + '

' + N'
Records Staged: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(100),@RecordsStaged) + '
' + N'
Vendor Name: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(100),@Vendor) + '
' + N'
Records Inserted into VendorResults table: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(100),@RecordsInserted) + '
' + N'
Total Error Records (VendorResults & SurveyAnswers): ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(100),@ErrorRecords) + '
' + N'See process log for error details.' + '' EXEC msdb.dbo.sp_send_dbmail @recipients=@ResultsEmailRecipients , @subject = @SUBJECT_VENDOR , @body = @tableHTML , @body_format = 'HTML'
